column3: Ids S028,S462,S469,S470 are the entry's `source:` line-1 S-token set exactly; Coverage "When a cache may assign a heuristic expiration time to a stored response and what lifetime it carries, one decision per stored response" derives from the entry ground line ("assigning a heuristic expiration time to a stored response over supplied integer seconds") and scope clause ("one decision per stored response under contract v1 of this lane"); "no clock, storage or revalidation" matches the scope's channel list ("Not a clock, ... a cache store, a revalidation exchange"); the row makes no per-id support attribution, so S028's named-but-disclaimed presence in line 1 does not falsify the Entry cell; entry disclaimers cover the rest.

Ids S477,S478 match line-1 exactly; Coverage "The method-token case rule and the list-member whitespace rule for If-Match and If-None-Match as RFC 9110 states them" is the entry scope sentence verbatim for those two rules and two fields, with the entry's quoted §9.1 (S477) and §5.6.1.2 (S478) spans; "entity-tag grammar and contract decisions stay out of scope" is the entry scope's own exclusions ("not entity-tag grammar or contract decisions"); body decliner bullets are separate v2-clause material the row never claims; no live-property/crawler/cache phrase exists.

Ids S449,S450,S451 match line-1 exactly; Coverage maps clause-per-clause: "Local-file normalized declarations" + "source-backed knowledge with explicit lane policies" = scope + Lane policy section; "expectation-free tool input and opaque matrix payloads" = amendment 2 B1; "Body declarations participate." = amendment 1 A1; "Historical directives ignored" = the sourced "The following rules aren't used by Google Search and are ignored" row; "bounded date grammar" = the Dates section's admitted lane-policy union; "findings separate from effective declarations" = Reporting-is-policy + B1; nothing extends past that text.

S019 is the metadata-authority id; Coverage enumerates the entry's sections verbatim-adjacent: "systemd 6h probe + daily keeper timers" = the watcher table's two rows; "probe-history semantics" = the "probe-history.jsonl — semantics and the transitions it recorded" section; "full CLI verb table" = "CLI surface beyond probe/reconcile"; "bots fleet" = the per-site grok-bot fleet sections; r18 prune-absence flags are inside the entry, so the row carries no claim beyond it.

Repair row adds S456 to the earlier S457-only Phase-1 row and the pair matches line-1's named ids ("S456 and S457 are two renderings of one document"); Coverage "freshness as age against a freshness lifetime" and "`max-age` as a delta-seconds argument that sets staleness" = the source-facts table rows (lines 587/621 for the two quantities; 1214-1220 for delta-seconds staleness); "unrecognized directives ignored" is the audit's own decision over unparseable directives (class table `unclassified` row; §2 "it rejects a name that is not a token"), described entry-side and not falsely attributed to the RFC; "the class names, verdict order and order-only rewrite equivalence are lane policy, not RFC text" = the `opinion` paragraph plus the r84 correction ("The label policy-rewritten-equivalent is a frozen tool label, not a field-independent equivalence guarantee"; "Do not use this tool to waive a policy drift alert or authorize publishing"); the header-class table stays entry-side and off-limits per the entry's own boundary.
